status: PROPOSAL, not wired: nothing reads this file; runtime/pi/form_selection.mjs is unchanged (3 live rules there under NEWSROOM_FORM_SKILL=1)

convention.basis: 成文 = the source states it in writing; 推断 = inference by fb/b8 (commentary, practice, transfer from another setting)
convention.action_rule_1: a rule with basis 推断 may only have action 'warn' (changes candidate order or gives a hint); never 'reject'
convention.action_rule_2: action 'reject' needs basis 成文 AND a computable condition (every condition field has status computed_today or derivable)
convention.action_rule_3: pending_rules (condition not computable today) carry action null and an intended_action; intended 'reject' still needs basis 成文
convention.floor: a user-named form is never dropped by a rule (form_selection.mjs enforces it); rules never grant verification status
convention.thresholds: taken verbatim from sources, strictest source on disagreement; where a source gives no number none is invented
convention.serious_topic: serious-topic proxy only (unit is people + indicator words); not a topic classification and not a standard

schema.scope: form (one chart/form) | page (several charts or the whole page)
schema.applies_to: form names as used in the atlas / CHART_TYPES; '*' = all; a form absent from viz.mjs CHART_TYPES means the rule is dormant until that form exists
schema.strength: 硬 (source says must/avoid/never) | 荐 (suggest/consider) | 原则 | — (inference)
schema.condition: {fields: names from `fields`, text: the condition in words}
schema.computable: true when every condition field is computed_today or derivable
schema.mirrors_runtime: true when the row mirrors a rule live in runtime/pi/form_selection.mjs
schema.origin: where the rule was collected from

value_min_max.source: same SUMMARIZE (min, max per column, as text)

category_count.source: distinct_count of the spec's category column; exact value needs COUNT(DISTINCT) through the existing DuckDB tool; form_selection.mjs formRuleHints takes profile.categories but nothing in production produces it

series_count.source: distinct_count of the spec's series_field; formRuleHints takes profile.series but nothing produces it

has_negative_value.source: value_min_max min < 0; viz.mjs:781 already computes the same test for streamgraph

has_time_column.source: column_type is DATE/TIMESTAMP in the schema profile

values_sum.source: SUM of the value column over the chart rows via the existing DuckDB tool; not computed today

value_is_integer.source: column_type is an integer type in the schema profile

unit_is_people_indicator.source: string match of spec.unit / measure name against a program-chosen word list (死亡 遇难 失踪 难民 流离失所, or unit = people); a proxy, not a topic classification (K305)

page_chart_types.source: chart_type of every module in the InfographicSpec / storyboard panels

adjacent_same_form_run.source: longest run of equal chart_type in page order, from page_chart_types

panel_count.source: distinct values of the small_multiples facet column; field name in spec not verified by b8

missing_fields.axis_min: value-axis lower bound of a rendered bar chart; the renderer chooses it and does not expose it as a field (not verified whether bars always start at 0)
missing_fields.dual_axis_flag: no spec field says a chart uses a second value axis
missing_fields.row_sorted_by_value: no check of result-row order; natural-order exception needs a flag
missing_fields.annotation_count_and_length: no spec field for annotations with counted length (not verified)
missing_fields.min_font_px: font sizes live inside renderer SVG code (viz.mjs uses sizes around 8.5-11 SVG units); not exposed as a field; do not wire without fe
missing_fields.colour_per_variable: palette assignment per variable across the page is not a field
missing_fields.colour_count_and_pair: number of colours and red/green pairing per chart are not fields
missing_fields.scale_mode_small_multiples: shared vs independent y-scale of small_multiples is not a field (not verified)
missing_fields.time_axis_domain: axis start/end per chart is not a field
missing_fields.chart_reason_statement: plan field where the model states why a view exists (diversity/complementarity/partition); a model judgement, the program can only check presence
missing_fields.chart_subtitle_with_data_region_time: chart spec has title/alt/source_note/unit; a subtitle with data+region+period is not a field (not verified)
missing_fields.overview_detail_order: no notion of overview vs detail panel in the page plan
missing_fields.flow_value_similarity: sources give no threshold for 'similar' flows
missing_fields.geo_kind_of_rows: region-coded vs point-coordinate rows is not a field
missing_fields.map_class_count: number of colour classes of a choropleth is renderer-internal (not verified)
missing_fields.projection: map projection is not a field (not verified)
missing_fields.category_semantic_group: category values are not profiled beyond min/max, so 'refugee / asylum seeker / IDP' classes cannot be recognised
missing_fields.individual_level_record: no flag that individual-level (traceable person or local detail) data exists
missing_fields.topic_mood: no theme/mood classifier; K305 found no public standard for one
missing_fields.pictogram_split: no pictogram/person-dot form in CHART_TYPES and no category-split flag
missing_fields.audience_knowledge: reader's statistical literacy is not a field
missing_fields.label_fit: label overflow is a render-QA fact, not a pre-render field
missing_fields.age_band_widths: pyramid band widths are not profiled
missing_fields.numeric_threshold_in_source: the source gives no number, and none is invented here
